title: Opposite operations
text: The variable already stands on its own apart from a constant. Remove the constant by applying the opposite operation to both sides.

title: Balance both sides
text: When we add $$5$$ to the left to isolate the variable, we must add $$5$$ to the right so that the equation remains balanced. \n $$y-5+5=9-5$$ \n $$y=14$$
